invariants: append only to the registered active workspace's evidence ledger
requirement resolves within the workspace's declared module or unit scope
exact snapshot and workspace revision guarded; receipt and retry preserve historical evidence
learner observations never update concept or source semantics

payload_schema.title: payload for capability learner.observation.append
payload_schema.description: Derived from the los CLI parser for this capability's named command. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with tools/generate_capability_schemas.py.

activity.description: what was done in the recorded attempt; free text

assistance.description: optional note on assistance used during the attempt

condition.description: a condition that DID hold for this attempt

condition_not_met.description: a condition that did NOT hold; a different fact from silence, which stays unknown

context.description: optional free-text context stored with the record

requirement.description: id of the requirement the evidence is recorded against

result.description: outcome of the recorded attempt: correct, incorrect, partial or abandoned

supersedes.description: explicitly correct one earlier observation; preserves its bytes

tags.description: comma-separated evidence tags for the record

workspace.description: id of the registered active workspace owning the ledger
